title: Joint sparse failure witnesses for eligible local quantum service
statement: Atomic all-lock ownership, short leases, a one-shot in-place U guarded by pending/done and an independent long deadline give state-independent productive probability p>0 in S time. Adaptive-start omissions are dominated by fixed E_fast union E_slow events, with beta_H and chi=3(d^2+1) as in the parent: every fixed marked set F obeys P(all witnesses)<=beta_H^(|F|/chi).

assumptions: The theorem starts AFTER causal eligibility. It does not bound predecessor wait or prove protected idles/controller-repair causal order. Illegal flags need a separate sparse damage/IDLE cleanup contract; arbitrary local GKLS is not silently CP-event uniformized.
costs: All service supports, rates and local dimensions are independent of device size for a chosen finite deadline H. Set h=H/(4 nu_d), m=max(0,floor(h/S)-2), beta_H=exp[-H(log2-1/2)]+(2h/S+4)(1-p)^m and chi=3(d^2+1). Any fixed marked witness set F has probability<=beta_H^(|F|/chi). Bath time is the displayed generator time: F_ent(t)<=(1+exp(-Ngt))/2; target error epsilon<1/2 needs t<=-log(1-2epsilon)/(Ng). Fixed physical coupling and uniform secular rates are not interchangeable. Driven resets consume power/export entropy; encoding/readout have separate contracts.
